scenes.role: Establish the family’s ordinary bustle and the gift idea.
actions: Notice the last dough and decide to thank the lender.
consequences: The siblings begin the task with distinct wants.
prose_obligations: Show the crowded kitchen, Mara’s gift-making wish, and Eli’s wish to share.
scenes.consolidation: Combined with finding the last dough and stating the goal.

scenes.role: Make the scarce resource visible.
actions: Move the covered bowl to the counter.
consequences: The only dough available becomes the task’s shared resource.
prose_obligations: Do not imply another batch is waiting offstage.
scenes.consolidation: The bowl is moved in the start mini-play; its amount is a validated parameter.

scenes.role: Give the siblings a concrete purpose.
actions: Agree to make a thank-you for Mrs. Flores.
consequences: A later gift or honest note can complete the task.
prose_obligations: Preserve both siblings’ ordinary motives.
scenes.consolidation: Goal-setting is enacted with moving the dough to the work counter.

scenes.role: Ask for the borrowed tools rather than treating them as owned.
prerequisites: The siblings have chosen the gift task.
actions: Go next door and ask for the cutters.
consequences: The siblings return with permission to use them.
prose_obligations: Make consent and borrowing clear.
scenes.consolidation: The visit, request, and return to the kitchen share one compact encounter.

scenes.role: Establish a real borrowed object and its lender’s needs.
actions: Receive the star and bell cutters with a request to return them dry.
consequences: The cutters can be used but remain Mrs. Flores’s property.
prose_obligations: The tools must later be returned clean and useful.
scenes.consolidation: The lender’s permission and return condition are part of the borrowing encounter.

scenes.role: Bring the tools to the kitchen.
prerequisites: Mrs. Flores has lent the cutters.
actions: Carry the tools home and make them ready.
consequences: The siblings can begin shaping the dough.
prose_obligations: Keep carrier and location consistent.
scenes.consolidation: Travel and inspection are local actions within borrowing.

scenes.role: Optional vignette connecting flouring the board to a shared memory.
prerequisites: The cutters have been borrowed; dough preparation has not begun.
actions: Recall how their grandmother let both children press a cutter.
consequences: Trust and listening persist into the division conversation.
prose_obligations: If omitted, do not narrate a shared recollection.
scenes.consolidation: Optional executable vignette; only its selected route changes memory and trust state.

scenes.role: Prepare a small work area amid family cooking.
actions: Dust the counter if flour is available; otherwise use chilled dough if possible.
consequences: Dough quality is established for the later bake.
prose_obligations: Do not claim warm, unfloured dough cuts cleanly.
scenes.consolidation: Counter space, flour, and dough readiness are one local play.

scenes.role: Make the oven ready without an unrelated light dependency.
actions: Preheat if it is not already warm.
consequences: The later bake can proceed.
prose_obligations: A functioning oven does not depend on kitchen lighting.
scenes.consolidation: Oven readiness is enacted during dough preparation.

scenes.role: Let the siblings disagree about the last dough.
prerequisites: The dough and tools are ready.
actions: Discuss gift-first versus an equal contribution.
consequences: A validated sharing choice assigns dough to gift and home portions.
prose_obligations: Keep Mara’s generosity and Eli’s fairness understandable.
scenes.consolidation: The argument and consequential choice are one scene; the selected plan is an explicit parameter.

scenes.role: Enact the reference story’s compromise.
actions: Give the gift equal portions from both siblings.
consequences: The recipient and siblings both receive a share of the last dough.
prose_obligations: Do not describe the equal plan when gift-first is selected.
scenes.consolidation: One of two local allocation outcomes, not a separate scene ID.

scenes.role: Optional playful pause while the oven warms.
prerequisites: Dough is prepared; division has not happened.
actions: Tap a kitchen rhythm together.
consequences: The shared song can be remembered during baking.
prose_obligations: If omitted, do not mention a song or its callback.
scenes.consolidation: Optional executable vignette; it cannot be silently applied when omitted.

scenes.role: Use the borrowed objects for their intended purpose.
prerequisites: Dough has been divided and cutters are ready.
actions: Cut shapes for the gift and home portion.
consequences: Cutting quality and gift mass determine whether a biscuit gift succeeds.
prose_obligations: Show the cutter’s usefulness and any smudging honestly.
scenes.consolidation: Cutting and baking are one scene-sized mini-play.

scenes.role: Bake the cut shapes.
prerequisites: The oven is preheated and shapes have been cut.
actions: Bake the gift and home portions.
consequences: A neat, sufficiently large gift portion becomes boxable; a failed batch can still be salvaged.
prose_obligations: A failure must lead to a complete, emotionally legible ending.
scenes.consolidation: The bake and its quality result are in the cutter mini-play.

scenes.role: Put gratitude into words.
actions: Write a short thank-you note.
consequences: The note accompanies either biscuits or an honest explanation.
prose_obligations: Do not make the note a substitute for returning the cutters.
scenes.consolidation: Writing and packing are combined to fit the short route.

scenes.role: Prepare the biscuit gift if it is viable.
actions: Box the biscuits or keep the note ready if the shapes failed.
consequences: The correct ending becomes available.
prose_obligations: Never box unmade or failed biscuits as a successful gift.
scenes.consolidation: Packing and the fallback note are outcomes of the same scene.

scenes.role: Restore the borrowed tools after use.
actions: Wash and dry them.
consequences: They are ready for Mrs. Flores’s own baking.
prose_obligations: Returning means usefulness, not only custody.
scenes.consolidation: Cleaning is enacted before either ending.

scenes.role: Bring the thanks to its recipient.
scenes.location: family kitchen to Mrs. Flores’s kitchen
prerequisites: The note and any gift are ready.
actions: Visit Mrs. Flores and deliver the selected thanks.
consequences: The gift or note is actually received.
prose_obligations: Do not end on an unfulfilled future plan.
scenes.consolidation: Travel and delivery are part of the selected ending.

scenes.role: Return the cutters in usable condition.
prerequisites: The cutters are clean and dry.
actions: Return them; Mrs. Flores uses one on her own dough.
consequences: Ownership and practical usefulness both return to the lender.
prose_obligations: Show the cutters working again.
scenes.consolidation: Both endings include the same physically enacted return and use.

scenes.role: Complete either the successful biscuit gift or the honest fallback.
prerequisites: The gift is boxed, or the batch has failed and the note is ready.
actions: Accept the recipient’s response and share the remaining home portion.
consequences: The story ends with a delivered thanks and reconciled siblings.
prose_obligations: Give success and failure emotionally complete outcomes.
scenes.consolidation: Two executable ending IDs represent the distinct viable-gift and honest-note outcomes.
